import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def draw_directed_graph(ax, nodes, caps) -> None:
    """Draw nodes and directed edges with capacity labels on axes."""
    for (u, v), cap in caps.items():
        x1, y1 = nodes[u]
        x2, y2 = nodes[v]
        dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
        ax.annotate(

            arrowprops={"arrowstyle": "-|>", "lw": 1.6,

    ("C", "E"), ("C", "F"), ("D", "E"), ("D", "F"),
